output.content: During our sync, {model_monica} explained the current workflow for tracking model iterations. She noted that there is no central repository for storing model artifacts or metadata. Instead, she keeps a local spreadsheet on her workstation to log experiment parameters and resulting metrics. When a new model version is ready for evaluation, she manually copies the file to a shared network drive and sends a direct message to the team with the file path. The spreadsheet currently lists forty-two distinct training runs from the past quarter, each with a timestamp and a brief description of the data split used. She mentioned that the file is updated only after a training run completes successfully, meaning any failed runs are not recorded in the log.
